name: National Archives of Trinidad and Tobago — General Registers of Indian Indentureship
summary: Seventeen large bound general-register volumes covering 298 ships, with registration number, immigrant name, father's name, sex, age, estate and later details such as recorded caste and Indian village.
rights: Institutional source; follow repository reproduction terms.

name: NATT — Indian Indentureship Records, General Registers (TT NATT IM 2)
summary: Chronological registers organized by ship; remarks may record birth, death, illness, return to India or land, with later registers adding native place and other descriptors.
rights: Finding aid reports no restriction on access; reproduction terms should still be checked.

name: NATT — Shared Memory: Indian Indentureship Records
summary: Describes general, estate and ship registers and the kinds of genealogical and migration fields preserved in them.

name: Nationaal Archief — Hindostani contract labourers in Suriname
summary: Research guide and index for tens of thousands of migrants, including personal/family information, voyage, origin and plantation/contract history.
rights: Check index/database reuse terms before bulk republication.

name: UNESCO Memory of the World — Records of Indian Indentured Labourers
coverage: Guyana, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago, Fiji, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
summary: International documentary-heritage context for major indentureship collections and their genealogical significance.
rights: Underlying repositories and items retain their own rights.

name: National Archives of Guyana — Indian Immigration
summary: Collection guide for immigration records including certificates, ship-related material, births and administrative correspondence.
rights: Follow National Archives of Guyana access and reproduction terms.
